newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mixed, Podravka extends gains.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mixed, Podravka extends gains.

text.p: Croatian stocks were mixed on Friday with food concern Podravka dominating the trade for the third straight day.
* Six of 14 active issues rose, six fell and two were flat.
* Volume down to 8,399 units, turnover halved to 3.6 million kuna.
* Biggest gainer hotelier Riviera Porec added 8 kuna or 5.8 percent to 138, on volume of 444 shares.
* Biggest decliner hotelier Istraturist lost 10 kuna or 5.9 percent to 160 on volume of 160 shares.
* Most active stock Podravka inched up 6 kuna to 276, selling 2,126 shares. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
